title: Development of FluoAHRL: A Novel Synthetic Fluorescent Compound That Activates AHR and Potentiates Anti-Inflammatory T Regulatory Cells.
authors: Jonic, Natalija; Koprivica, Ivan; Chatzigiannis, Christos M; Tsiailanis, Antonis D; Kyrkou, Stavroula G; Tzakos, Eleftherios Paraskevas; Pavic, Aleksandar; Dimitrijevic, Mirjana; Jovanovic, Andjelina; Jovanovic, Milan B; Marinho, Sergio; Castro-Almeida, Ines; Otasevic, Vesna; Moura-Alves, Pedro; Tzakos, Andreas G; Stojanovic, Ivana
one_liner_zh: 该文开发荧光AHR配体并研究其抗炎Treg免疫调节作用，虽含分子对接预测，但核心是免疫药理而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor (AHR) ligands, upon binding, induce distinct gene expression profiles orchestrated by the AHR, leading to a spectrum of pro- or anti-inflammatory effects. In this study, we designed, synthesized and evaluated three indole-containing potential AHR ligands (FluoAHRL: AGT-4, AGT-5 and AGT-6). All synthesized compounds were shown to emit fluorescence in the near-infrared. Their AHR agonist activity was first predicted using in silico docking studies, and then confirmed using AHR luciferase reporter cell lines. FluoAHRLs were tested in vitro using mouse peritoneal macrophages and T lymphocytes to assess their immunomodulatory properties. We then focused on AGT-5, as it illustrated the predominant anti-inflammatory effects. Notably, AGT-5 demonstrated the ability to foster anti-inflammatory regulatory T cells (Treg) while suppressing pro-inflammatory T helper (Th)17 cells in vitro. AGT-5 actively induced Treg differentiation from naive CD4(+) cells, and promoted Treg proliferation, cytotoxic T-lymphocyte-associated antigen 4 (CTLA-4) expression and interleukin-10 (IL-10) production. The increase in IL-10 correlated with an upregulation of Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 3 (STAT3) expression. Importantly, the Treg-inducing effect of AGT-5 was also observed in human tonsil cells in vitro. AGT-5 showed no toxicity when applied to zebrafish embryos and was therefore considered safe for animal studies. Following oral administration to C57BL/6 mice, AGT-5 significantly upregulated Treg while downregulating pro-inflammatory Th1 cells in the mesenteric lymph nodes. Due to its fluorescent properties, AGT-5 could be visualized both in vitro (during uptake by macrophages) and ex vivo (within the lamina propria of the small intestine). These findings make AGT-5 a promising candidate for further exploration in the treatment of inflammatory and autoimmune diseases.
abstract_zh: 芳香烃受体（Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor, AHR）配体在结合后，诱导由AHR调控的不同基因表达谱，从而产生一系列促炎或抗炎效应。在本研究中，我们设计、合成并评估了三种含吲哚结构的潜在AHR配体（FluoAHRL：AGT-4、AGT-5和AGT-6）。所有合成的化合物均显示在近红外区域发射荧光。其AHR激动剂活性首先通过计算机模拟对接研究预测，随后使用AHR荧光素酶报告细胞系进行确认。FluoAHRLs在小鼠腹膜巨噬细胞和T淋巴细胞中进行了体外测试，以评估其免疫调节特性。我们随后聚焦于AGT-5，因为它表现出主要的抗炎效应。值得注意的是，AGT-5在体外展示了促进抗炎性调节性T细胞（Treg）生成，同时抑制促炎性辅助性T细胞（Th）17细胞的能力。AGT-5主动诱导初始CD4(+)细胞分化为Treg，并促进Treg增殖、细胞毒性T淋巴细胞相关抗原4（CTLA-4）表达及白细胞介素-10（IL-10）产生。IL-10的增加与信号转导及转录激活因子3（STAT3）表达的上调相关。重要的是，AGT-5的Treg诱导效应也在人扁桃体细胞中体外观察到。AGT-5在应用于斑马鱼胚胎时未显示毒性，因此被认为适合动物研究。在口服给予C57BL/6小鼠后，AGT-5显著上调肠系膜淋巴结中的Treg，同时下调促炎性Th1细胞。由于其荧光特性，AGT-5在体外（巨噬细胞摄取过程中）和离体（小肠固有层内）均可被可视化。这些发现使AGT-5成为进一步探索治疗炎症性和自身免疫性疾病的 promising 候选分子。
